([[Cordova, Tennessee]]) | college = [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]] (2021–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 38 | draft_team = [[San Antonio Spurs]] | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|full=y}} | team1 = [[Indiana Pacers]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team2 = →[[Noblesville Boom]] | years3 = {{nbay|2026|start}}–present | team3 = [[Milwaukee Bucks]] | years4 = [[2026–27 NBA G League season|2026]]–present | team4 = →[[Wisconsin Herd]] | highlights = * Consensus second-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2025 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2025]]) * First-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2025) * Second-team All-Big East (2023) * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman team (2022) }} '''Kam Jones''' is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Wisconsin Herd]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette Golden Eagles]]. ==Early life and high school career== Jones grew up in [[Memphis, Tennessee]] and boxed in addition to playing basketball.{{cite news |title=Marquette Golden Eagles' Kam Jones likes basketball and boxing |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2023/11/20/marquette-golden-eagles-kam-jones-likes-basketball-and-boxing/71619918007/ |access-date=January 14, 2024 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |date=November 20, 2023}} He attended [[Evangelical Christian School]], where he was coached by Willie Jenkins. Despite not being the most athletic player, Jones sometimes played at center to enhance his skills around the rim.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/12/16/marquette-basketball-breakout-sophomore-kam-jones-having-success-2022-23-season/69729350007/|title=An artist in the paint: How Marquette's Kam Jones learned creative ways to score around the basket|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=December 16, 2022|access-date=January 14, 2024}} He averaged 14.3 points, 4.2 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game as a sophomore and was named to the All-District team.{{cite web |title=Standout Prep Guard Kameron Jones Joins Marquette |url=https://gomarquette.com/news/2020/11/11/mens-basketball-standout-prep-guard-kameron-jones-joins-marquette |website=[[Marquette Golden Eagles]] |access-date=January 15, 2024 |date=November 11, 2020}} As a junior, Jones averaged 19.1 points, 5.5 rebounds and 3.4 assists per game.{{cite news |last1=Branham |first1=Travis |title=2021 combo guard Kameron Jones commits to Marquette |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Kameron-Jones-commitment-Marquette-148685570/ |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=247 Sports |date=June 30, 2020}} Jones committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]] over offers from [[South Alabama Jaguars men's basketball|South Alabama]] and [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]].{{cite news |last=Thompson|first=Khari|url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/high-school/2020/06/22/high-school-basketball-ecs-kameron-jones-having-air-force-dad/3191050001/|title=How having an Air Force sergeant for a dad shaped ECS basketball star Kameron Jones|date=June 22, 2020 |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[The Commercial Appeal]]}} ==College career== Jones averaged 7.4 points per game as a freshman, earning [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{cite news |last1=Steele |first1=Ben |title=Aggressiveness is paying off with free throws for Marquette guard Kam Jones |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/marquette/2022/12/05/marquette-basketball-guard-kam-jones-earning-more-free-throws/69701326007/ |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |date=December 5, 2022}} As a sophomore, Jones averaged 15.1 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 1.4 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=McCleary |first1=Michael |title=Analyzing the difficulty of Wisconsin men's basketball's nonconference schedule |url=https://badgerextra.com/sports/basketball/men/wisconsin-mens-basketball-nonconference-analysis/article_80d5b7d2-4099-11ee-8ddc-23166091769b.html |website=Badger Extra |access-date=January 14, 2024 |date=August 23, 2023}} He was named to the Second Team All-Big East.{{cite web |title=All-BIG EAST Teams Announced |url=https://www.bigeast.com/news/2023/3/5/mens-basketball-all-big-east-teams-announced.aspx |website=[[Big East Conference]] |access-date=January 15, 2024 |date=March 5, 2023}} In the NCAA Tournament, he scored 18 straight points in a 78–61 first round win against [[Vermont Catamounts men's basketball|Vermont]].{{cite news |last1=Stacy |first1=Mitch |title=March Madness: Jones, Marquette roll over Vermont 78–61 |url=https://apnews.com/article/march-madness-vermont-marquettencaa-tournament-f95c79547ea1ba0c37043e6a2ca01760 |access-date=January 15, 2024 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=March 17, 2023}} As a junior, Jones averaged 17.2 points, 2.4 assists, 2.9 rebounds and 1.1 steals per game. He helped Marquette reach the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament.{{cite web |last1=Gambill |first1=Mike |title=Kam Jones staying put at Marquette Basketball for 2024-25 season |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/posts/kam-jones-staying-put-at-marquette-basketball-for-2024-25-season-01hv9f1tb54f |website=Busting Brackets |access-date=January 4, 2025 |date=April 12, 2024}} As a senior, Jones averaged 19.2 points, 5.9 assists and 4.5 rebounds per game and was a consensus Second Team All-American.{{cite news |title=Indiana Pacers select Memphis native Kam Jones in 2025 NBA draft |url=https://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/high-school/2025/06/26/kam-jones-memphis-nba-draft-indiana-pacers-ecs/84335412007/ |access-date=July 7, 2025 |work=[[The Commercial Appeal]] |date=June 26, 2025}} ==Professional career== ===Indiana Pacers / Noblesville Boom (2025–2026)=== Jones was selected with the 38th pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]] by the [[San Antonio Spurs]], then traded to the [[Indiana Pacers]].{{cite web |last1=Hotchkiss |first1=Wheat |title=Kam Jones Eager to Impact Winning in Indiana |url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/kam-jones-eager-to-impact-winning-in-indiana |website=NBA.com |access-date=July 7, 2025 |date=July 7, 2025}} Jones made his professional debut for the Pacers' [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Noblesville Boom]], on December 19. He then made his NBA debut on December 22 for the Pacers, scoring two points in one minute of action. On June 24, 2026, Jones was traded to the [[Chicago Bulls]] in exchange for the draft rights of the 38th pick, [[Braden Smith (basketball)|Braden Smith]],{{cite news |last=Schuster |first=Elias |title=Bulls trade No. 38 to Pacers for Kam Jones in questionable draft-night move |url=https://www.si.com/nba/bulls/onsi/bulls-trade-no-38-to-pacers-for-kam-jones-in-questionable-draft-night-move-24 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}}{{cite news |last=Poe |first=Julia |title=NBA draft: Chicago Bulls trade their two 2nd-round picks and reportedly acquire Kam Jones from Indiana Pacers |url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/2026/06/24/chicago-bulls-nba-draft-kam-jones/ |work=[[Chicago Tribune]]|date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}} but was waived by the Bulls on June 30.{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/bulls-waive-former-pacers-guard-kam-jones-who-was-dealt-for-braden-smith-221432953.html|title=Bulls waive former Pacers guard Kam Jones, who was dealt for Braden Smith|first=Dustin|last=Dopirak|work=Indianapolis Star|via=Yahoo! Sports|date=June 30, 2026|accessdate=July 1, 2026}} ===Milwaukee Bucks / Wisconsin Herd (2026–present)=== On July 5, 2026, Jones signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web|title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Kam Jones To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-kam-jones-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=July 5, 2026|access-date=July 6, 2026}} ==Personal life== On October 20, 2025, Jones was arrested after a {{convert|4|mi|spell=in|adj=on}} police chase, where Jones was reportedly going {{cvt|90|mph}} in a {{cvt|55|mph}} zone. Jones was charged with [[reckless driving]] and [[Resisting arrest|resisting law enforcement]] charges.{{Cite web |date=2025-10-20 |title='Running late' {{!}} Pacers rookie arrested after brief police
